director.text: Hi Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj cricket ke overs se fractions ko number line par dekhenge. Cricket dekhna pasand hai?
Riya, cricket pitch ko number line samjho. Start se end tak ka raasta do barabar hisson mein baanto: aadhe raaste ka nishaan kahan lagaogi? Aakhir mein Golu ko samjhaogi.
Riya, socho 0 se 1 tak do barabar gaps hain. Woh 0 ke baad aayega ya 1 ke baad?
Riya, 4 yahan nahi aayega; aadha nishaan 0 aur 1 ke beech hoga. 2/5 ke liye 0 aur 1 ke beech kitne barabar gaps banaogi?
Riya, 5 neeche hai, isliye 0 se 1 ko 5 barabar gaps mein baantte hain. Ab 2/5 ka nishaan kis gap par lagaogi?
